attribution: Climate shares are approximate. For countries large enough to contain a 0.5° grid cell centre, they are area-weighted fractions of Beck et al. (2018) Köppen–Geiger land cells (CC BY 4.0) assigned with Natural Earth Admin 0 1:50m boundaries (public domain). Tiny territories use a sample of GeoNames capitals and cities (CC BY 4.0) instead of an area share. Small fragments, coasts, and overseas holdings can be misclassified at this resolution. The inset map uses the principal land cluster and may omit far-flung territories.

sources.title: Present and future Köppen-Geiger climate classification maps at 1-km resolution
